prompt: Imagine a futuristic assembly line of asset production and create a story line for a video of a cinematic epic trailer with controlled pacing, dramatic camera movement, and story-driven editing.GOAL:Re-edit and reinterpret the footage into a high-end cinematic trailer with slow, deliberate camera motion and emotional build-up.---EDITING STRUCTURE:- Re-cut the video into a trailer structure: 1. Opening: slow, atmospheric, wide shots 2. Build-up: medium shots, gradual increase in pacing 3. Climax: faster cuts, strongest visuals 4. Ending: short impactful closing shot- Use longer shots at the beginning (3-5 seconds)- Gradually shorten shot length toward the end- Use hard cuts only (no transitions, no effects)- Align cuts with emotional beats and implied music rhythm---CAMERA MOVEMENT (CRUCIAL):Apply cinematic virtual camera movement to ALL shots:- Slow push-in (digital zoom forward) on key subjects- Subtle parallax / orbital movement to create depth- Occasional slow pull-back for dramatic reveal- Add slight vertical drift for realismDO NOT:- Use handheld shake- Use fast or chaotic motion- Use abrupt zoomsMovement must feel:slow, heavy, intentional, cinematic---SHOT SELECTION:- Prioritize: strong compositions clear subjects moments with visual depth- Reframe shots where needed: start wider → end closer (within same shot if possible) emphasize scale and subject importance---MOTION TREATMENT:- Apply subtle slow motion where appropriate- Add micro-movements: particles (dust, fog, atmosphere) slight environmental motionKeep overall motion minimal but meaningful---COLOR & LIGHTING:- Apply cinematic color grading: cool tones (blue/teal bias) slightly desaturated high contrast- Add: soft bloom on highlights volumetric light / haze deeper shadows for drama---DEPTH & CINEMA EFFECTS:- Add depth of field (background slightly blurred)- Enhance foreground/background separation- Introduce atmospheric layers (fog, light rays, particles)---MOOD & TONE:- Epic, emotional, cinematic- Controlled, slow, powerful- Build tension gradually- Avoid commercial/fast social media style---OUTPUT:- Feels like a AAA cinematic trailer- Smooth, intentional camera motion- Strong narrative pacing- Dramatic and immersive atmosphere --chaos 10 --ar 16:9 --profile 95j3k3o
